decision: ADR 0073: Keep entity details focused on the entity
scope: Entity-first Monitoring details, separate page filters and tree controls, and explicit issue/notification/availability action wording.

local_checks.environment: WSL Ubuntu, prepared Homeostatic environment, Node 24.22.0

component_contents.release_archive: Not built; this is an uncommitted local change, not a release candidate.

browser_scenarios.transport: Synthetic Home Assistant replies and mocked service calls; no live installation

results.controls: All, Monitored, Not monitored, source selection, existing History links and monitoring actions
results.expected: All entities remain browsable; actual checks determine coverage, filters retain context without saving, and entity condition and actions stay visible.
evidence: Rendered All/Monitored/Not monitored controls, entity condition and zero value, no entity disclosure or technical metadata, existing history URL, Configure monitoring and return, visible policy links and scoped stop, live-render focus, filter context, no horizontal overflow and unchanged settings.

results.controls: Battery, device and entity selection; Details, View history, Configure monitoring and return
results.expected: Entity details have a direct condition, coverage sentence and policy links; devices and batteries retain labelled evidence and Details, and navigation never saves.
evidence: Rendered entity-first details alongside retained battery and device facts, independent unavailable/unmonitored battery state, single and paired readings, Details guidance, history, Policies/return, compact context, source actions and unchanged settings without horizontal overflow.

results.controls: Search, Monitoring status, More filters, active count, keyboard/pointer dismissal, Group by and Collapse groups
results.expected: Page filters stay in one stable toolbar; grouping and collapse affect only the tree; choices, focus and selected details survive updates without a save.
evidence: Rendered ordered page filters and tree-only group controls, native filter opening without toolbar movement, active filter count, focused checkbox and open panel retained through render, saved navigation context, stable Collapse groups and selected source, search-forced expansion and unchanged settings. Native Escape and outside-click dismissal require the accompanying browser keyboard/pointer check.

result: PASS: 6 source action paths; other inventory paths remain untested by this fixture.

results.controls: Remove group entities, details, cancel, confirm
results.expected: One guarded save commits policy exclusions; the resulting issue list has no persistent success message or Undo.
evidence: Actual group action, short confirmation, collapsed Details, Cancel, one saved entity/device exclusion change and no Undo after the group disappears; top-level History and Issues navigation preserve the save. Unknown/off siblings and notification settings preserved.

results.controls: Stop availability, cancel, confirm, resume
results.expected: Only reviewed saved policy exclusions change; unrelated drafts and HA state remain intact.
evidence: Actual Stop, Cancel, confirm, reopen and Resume controls, with no saved-action Undo; exact two-policy exclusions; unchanged unavailable state and unrelated unsaved policy/method drafts.

results.controls: Select members, stop selected, resume selected, exclusions filter
results.expected: One save affects only selected entities; excluded members remain reachable.
evidence: Device checkboxes select exactly two entities for one save; omitted excluded members remain reachable for selective resumption; exclusion filter retains only excluded branches.

results.controls: Dirty affected policy, stale review, save failure, deliberate retry
results.expected: Block unsafe scope changes and preserve saved settings and drafts.
evidence: Actual controls block affected drafts, stale settings and changed catalogs; disconnected controls are read-only; rejected saves accept deliberate retry; lost applied-save response has no automatic retry or false success and refresh prevents a duplicate write.

results.controls: View issue, Acknowledge issue and Pause notifications dialogs, cancel
results.expected: Entity details link to the exact related issue; only the full issue view exposes its acknowledgment and notification controls.
evidence: Entity details show broader issue scope and View issue without local acknowledgment or pause. Opened exact shared issue, checked Acknowledge issue and Pause notifications labels, cancelled both dialogs and returned without sending an action request.

results.controls: Visible entity policy links and actions, retained focus, phone/desktop and themes
results.expected: Entity condition and actions need no disclosure and remain reachable without horizontal scroll.
evidence: Visible entity policy and action retain focus through rerender without Details; Stop review/Cancel work at 320, 390 and 1200 CSS pixels in light and dark; no required horizontal scrolling; primary action meets 44px touch target. Physical Safari untested.

results.controls: Expand, select, search, filter
results.expected: Expansion and selection stay independent; identity and context persist.
evidence: Clicked integration/device/entity selections, collapse/expand and Collapse groups; dispatched ArrowLeft/Right on the focused rendered toggle; typed entity-ID and no-match searches, changed grouping and Show disabled. Verified independent selection, keyboard focus, retained canonical identity and disabled monitoring copy.

results.controls: Members, readings, monitoring, issue links
results.expected: Current evidence and contributing policies are distinguishable.
evidence: Clicked current device member readings, shared Details and other readings, entity member, verified integration link (intercepted in this isolated fixture), directly visible contributing policy and Monitoring return. Verified unavailable/no-value/numeric distinctions, separate device/entity policy links, no entity technical/disclosure blocks, exact policy editor and no configuration mutation. Retry reading and issue navigation were exercised in sources.history.

results.controls: History, prior problem, return
results.expected: Recorded membership survives unavailable current source metadata.
evidence: Clicked Monitoring, MQTT, View history and cleared/joined/removed rows; followed related issue into Monitoring and used Back with focus return. Verified recorded ownership/name after current child deletion, retention text, stale read-only/reconnect, actual Retry reading/Retry connection, no mutations and no horizontal overflow at the recorded card width.

results.controls: Equipment maintenance entry, explicit expiry, cancel
results.expected: A source has a reachable maintenance action with exact saved scope and visible expiry.
evidence: Clicked source maintenance entry, invalid custom time, explicit preset duration, optional reason, dependent-scope choice, Save and End now. Verified collapsed options, no pristine validation warning and retained exact expiry. Verified pending-click suppression, ambiguous failure with no retry, disconnected submission gate, exact mock persisted source/expiry/reason, reopened source control and preservation of an overlapping window on cancellation.
